concerns.text: FR-001 (Dataset Mismatch Halt) requires a schema file and validation logic. T010 is marked incomplete and relies on T008b (schema generation) which is also incomplete. Without these, the critical data integrity check defined in the spec and plan cannot be enforced.

FR-009 (Pair Validation) requires excluding subjects with missing fMRI/MWQ pairs and logging counts. T013 is marked incomplete, leaving no task to implement this exclusion logic or produce the required log output.
FR-008 (Motion Exclusion) requires excluding subjects with mean FD > 0.5mm and logging counts/IDs. T014 is marked incomplete, creating a gap where the system cannot enforce the motion hygiene rule.
Edge Cases (Zero Variance) require excluding subjects with global_signal_sd == 0 and logging a warning. T015 is marked incomplete, leaving no task to implement this exclusion or warning logic.
SC-005 (Independence of GSA effect) requires partial correlation analysis controlling for mean FD. T030 is marked incomplete, meaning the success criterion cannot be verified or reported.
SC-001 to SC-005 require a final aggregated report. T034a is marked incomplete, leaving no task to generate the final_report.json containing all success criteria status.
SC-001 to SC-005 require explicit pass/fail status in the final report. T034b is marked incomplete, meaning the report cannot explicitly state whether criteria are met.
Plan Phase 3 Step 2 requires generating visualizations (null_dist.png, alpha_sweep.png, corr_matrix.png). T035 is marked incomplete, leaving no task to produce these required artifacts.
Plan Phase 3 Step 3 (Final Review) implies an end-to-end integration test. T036 is marked incomplete, leaving no task to verify the full pipeline works on sample data.
Plan Phase 2 Step 2 requires a Power Analysis (MDES calculation) and logging. No corresponding task exists in tasks.md to implement this analysis or generate the log output.
